visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair is seen lying in bed, snuggling an orange tabby cat. She is wearing a black bra top and the scene is lit with soft, warm indoor lighting against a plain white wall. (2) She sits up on the bed, now covered by a black-and-white spotted blanket, and begins peeling a translucent facial mask off her cheek. The camera focuses on her facial expressions and the physical state of the mask. (3) The setting shifts to a more organized indoor space where she wears a green robe; she massages a white cleansing balm into her face, with a background of shelving and household items. (4) She holds up a clear toner bottle and applies soaked cotton pads to her forehead and cheeks, creating a temporary mask. The background shows organized storage bins. (5) She mixes a bright green powder into a glass of water with a metal straw and drinks it while still wearing the toner pads. The lighting is bright and natural. (6) She is seen sitting cross-legged in a meditative pose on the floor while a black cat walks past. A large mirror and curtains are visible in the background. (7) A fast-paced montage shows her using a cream tube and a pink beauty device with a glowing green tip to massage her skin. (8) She proceeds through a detailed makeup routine involving facial spray, sunscreen, cushion foundation, eyeshadow, eyebrow styling, an eyelash curler, and lip tint. She is now wearing a plaid sleeveless dress. (9) The video concludes with her smiling and posing, showcasing the finished makeup look. High-contrast cinematic lighting highlights her glowing skin and the red lip color.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio sequence begins with a bright, digital 'ding' notification chime followed by a distinct cat meow. The background is quiet, highlighting these initial transients. (2) Soft rustling of fabrics and bedding is audible, indicating movement in a domestic setting. (3) A dry, isolated cough occurs, followed immediately by a tactile 'peeling' sound effect with high-frequency emphasis, mimicking the removal of a mask. (4) A sharp 'pop' sound effect marks a visual transition, and an upbeat, high-tempo K-pop dance track with female vocals begins. The music is characterized by a driving electronic beat and bright synth melodies. (5) A series of 'click' and 'pop' SFX are perfectly synced to container openings, followed by a 'glug' liquid pouring sound and rhythmic metallic stirring against a glass. (6) The music maintains dominance throughout a montage of fast edits, overlaid with frequent 'bubble pop' and 'whoosh' sound effects that emphasize the quick application of various skincare and makeup products. (7) A final 'shhh' spray sound is heard, and the track continues with high energy until it reaches a concluding point with a final subtle digital shimmer.
